newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Albright agent shoots himself in foot.
newsitem.headline: Albright agent shoots himself in foot.

text.p: One of the U.S. security agents assigned to U.S. Secretary of State Madeleine Albright shot himself in the foot when he accidentally fired his gun, State Department spokesman Nicholas Burns said on Monday.
The agent, whose name was not made public, was treated at a local hospital and released shortly after the incident on Friday night.
"The bullet went right through his foot" but he was walking the next day and left Malaysia on Monday for the United States, Burns told Reuters when asked about a newspaper report.
The incident occurred soon after Albright arrived at the Sunway Lagoon Resort near Kuala Lumpur, where the Association of South East Asian Nations (ASEAN) is holding its annual meeting.
U.S. officials did not mention the incident until it was reported on Monday in the local newspaper.
The agent was checking his weapon, with the barrel pointed down, when the gun went off.
